The Condensed Matter group welcomes applications to join the Ph.D. programme for the next academic year. The students will be selected through a competition based on academic qualifications, a written exam and an interview held at SISSA (or via Skype/videoconference for candidates who can not reach Trieste). The School can contribute to the travel expenses for attending the exams up to a maximum of 150 euros.
The deadline for the Spring opening is early in March of every year (see details in the call for applications). Applications can be submitted online. A second call will be announced in September only if some positions will not be assigned after the first call.
The Ph.D. program and the classes will start in the first week October.
Contact us
To get more information and the deadlines for sending your application, please contact us.
